task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the correct Jitsi Meet URL.
Agent enters the required display name before or upon joining.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Maria Interpreter' is typed into the name field on the pre-join screen or visible in the participant list.

task_completion.description: Agent successfully enters the meeting room interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Jitsi meeting interface (toolbar, video tiles/avatars) is visible, indicating the agent is no longer on the landing/lobby page.
A hand icon is visible on the agent's video tile or participant entry, or the hand icon in the toolbar changes state (e.g., changes color or shows a notification dot).

task_completion.description: Agent opens the Speaker Stats panel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A modal or side panel titled 'Speaker Stats' is visible over the meeting interface, listing participants and their speaking time.

integrity.description: Agent used the graphical user interface rather than terminal commands to join and interact.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movement and clicks on UI buttons (Join, Hand icon, More actions menu) rather than shell commands.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the Jitsi web application elements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Speaker Stats panel and Hand Raise status appear as native parts of the Jitsi DOM/UI, not as static images or text overlays.

integrity.description: Agent did not bypass the name entry requirement if prompted by the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen interacting with the name input field to set 'Maria Interpreter'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The correct URL is http://localhost:8080/InterpreterSession2024. The required display name is 'Maria Interpreter'. The speaker statistics panel in Jitsi is explicitly titled 'Speaker Stats'. To verify the hand is raised, look for a small hand icon on the user's thumbnail or a blue/colored highlight on the hand button in the bottom toolbar.
